detail.longDescription: I built MastoSky — a free, local-first web client that brings Mastodon and Bluesky together in one tab. • Unified timeline that merges duplicate cross-posts • Write once (300/500): single 500-char post on Mastodon, auto-split thread on Bluesky • Multi-column Deck view, saved collections, Reader View, custom feeds/lists & DMs • 100% local & private (macOS/Windows/Linux apps, Docker/CasaOS & mobile PWA) https:// gjmcosta.github.io/MastoSky/ # Mastodon # Fediverse # Bluesky # OpenSource # SelfHosted
